description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Twin Element Mode (Lightning, Dark) v2], [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Cloud of Darkness], [Ultra Particle Beam Damage Tracker] and [Ultra Particle Beam Level]

description.name: Twin Element Mode (Lightning, Dark) v2
description.text: Grants [Attach Lightning]/[Attach Dark] after using a Lightning or Dark ability

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Cloud of Darkness
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Ultra Particle Beam (0~2), removed after using Ultra Particle Beam two times

description.name: Ultra Particle Beam Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Ultra Particle Beam level by 1 after dealing 100001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Cloud of Darkness]

description.name: Ultra Particle Beam Level
description.text: Keeps track of Ultra Particle Beam level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Cloud of Darkness]
